paragraphs.text: The Official Magic: The Gathering - Strategies & Secrets is a book published by Sybex Inc. in February, 1997. It was wirren by Beth Moursund , editor of the Duelist .

The book was advertised as the only official strategy guide to Magic: The Gathering Microprose computer game . Players would learn all of the secrets of the game, the hidden pitfalls, and glorious treasures. Illustrated with scores of screenshots from the game and actual reproductions of the game's cards, the book also includes a four-color section that shows all the new cards that were only available in the PC version of the game .
